name: Kasiol 3
description: Kasiol 3, also known as Kasiol's third planet, was a world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Pelgrin sector. Its surface featured forests and numerous swamps. The local fauna included the herlixx, a species of amphibian omnivore that hunted fish and smaller amphibians. Kasiol 3 had been colonized by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire.
